definitions.gloss: since ancient times, from olden days
definitions.explanation: From the distant past up to the present; traditionally.

examples.japanese: {古来|こらい}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{伝|つた}わる→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a tradition that has been passed down since ancient times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{古来|こらい}、⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧だった。
examples.english: In Japan, rice has been the staple food since ancient times.

examples.japanese: {古来|こらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|い}かす。
examples.english: To apply ancient wisdom to modern times.

notes:
{古来|こらい} means "since ancient times" and can function as both a noun and an adverb. It is composed of {古|こ} (old) + {来|らい} (coming from).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {古来|こらい}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: since ancient times (literary)
- {古来|こらい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since ancient times (slightly more colloquial)
- {古来|こらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧: wisdom from ancient times
- {古来|こらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧: traditions from ancient times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from long ago (everyday, conversational)
- {太古|たいこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧: since very ancient times (emphasizes remoteness)
- ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: traditionally (focuses on custom, not time)
- ⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧: conventionally, up to now (not as far back as {古来|こらい})

REGISTER:
{古来|こらい} has a formal, literary tone. In casual speech, ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ is more natural. {古来|こらい} is commonly found in written Japanese, especially when discussing history, culture, or traditions.
